intro_strings: Trekking near a copse of trees where the waves swish at their paws, the patrol notices a huge blue crab picking at a coconut.
decline_strings: Deciding that it looks too dangerous to approach, the patrol leaves the crab alone.

strings: The patrol watches as the crab hauls a coconut up the tree, only to drop it with a heavy crack before scrambling down to retrieve it and start again. The strange routine leaves the cats puzzled, but they can't help admiring its determination.

The crab is huge, but surely it can't be that dangerous. However, when p_l describes a story {PRONOUN/p_l/subject} once heard about this giant creature killing a fully-grown cat, the group decides to steer clear. Maybe it's best to continue on with their patrol instead.

Watching the crab attempt to crack open a coconut, the patrol proposes a plan that's inspired by its technique. While they don't have scuttling legs or strong pinchers, the cats are able to gather rocks into a palm tree and send them crashing down onto the coconut below. A sharp crack of the shell indicates their success, and they happily feast on the fruity, fleshy innards.

log.cats_from: cat_from had fun cracking open a coconut with cat_to.

strings: s_c0 ventures too near, and the crab's massive claw snaps shut just short of {PRONOUN/s_c0/poss} face. Startled, {PRONOUN/s_c0/subject} {VERB/s_c0/leap/leaps} back into the sand, fur bristling and claws unsheathed. That was far too close! Maybe this is one border threat better left alone.
s_c0 approaches the crab, but it lashes out with terrifying speed. Its crushing pincers clamp down, leaving {PRONOUN/s_c0/object} badly injured before {PRONOUN/s_c0/subject} can fully retreat.

condition.scar_history: m_c's bone was broken by a coconut crab.
condition.death_history: m_c couldn't recover from {PRONOUN/m_c/poss} broken bone after being pinched by a coconut crab.

strings: s_c0 lunges to drive the crab off, but its pincers strike {PRONOUN/s_c0/object} with a brutal force {PRONOUN/s_c0/subject} can't escape from. The patrol can only watch in horror as the attack proves fatal.
